items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I remember Buddy around here and when I was in Florida and I first went there, he had been and left and he went to Montgomery.

ctx.x: No, that type of people that they played for.
Do you ever play with Buddy Petillo, Chris Kelly, Rene?
No, I didn't say play in their band, but I remember Buddy around here and when I was in Florida and I first went there, he had been and left and he went to Montgomery.
